description: Uptown Bicycle Counts is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. This count reflects cyclists traveling through Manhattan at on 86th Street along the avenues, in Central Park and on the greenways. Note: Data was not collected in years for which counts are missing. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are crosstown, greenways, uptown, central park, volume. The table has 21 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation (DOT). The portal shows 2025-10-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
